description: An ivory patterned floor-length court gown has a low square neckline, structured bodice, elbow-length sleeves and a narrow below-knee walking opening. Plum and gold woven trim runs around the neckline, cuffs, front and waist. A plum wrap hangs from small round shoulder clasps and rests around the arms, with gold embroidery at its edges. Small earrings, a pendant necklace, bracelets and rings accompany a visible gold patterned shoe.
